deferrals.name: mcp
deferrals.reason: openhands-sdk 1.55.1 requires fastmcp>=3.2.0,<4, which requires mcp<2.0. Defer MCP 2.x until a supported SDK/fastmcp release removes that constraint.

deferrals.name: *tauri*
deferrals.reason: Stable 2.x pins applied (API/CLI 2.12.1, tauri/runtime/runtime-wry 2.12.1, tauri-macros/build 2.7.1); newest upstream releases are 3.0.0-alpha.* pre-releases. Recheck when a stable 3.x ships.

deferrals.name: emscripten/emsdk
deferrals.reason: emsdk 6.0.10 vendors npm/emscripten node_modules and a TypeScript go binary (tsc) carrying ~56 Trivy CRITICAL/HIGH findings covered by expiring .trivyignore waivers; re-scan on the next emsdk release and drop cleared waivers.

deferrals.name: node
deferrals.reason: the verified upstream Node tarball bundles npm's vendored deps (brace-expansion, undici) flagged by Trivy under expiring .trivyignore waivers; re-scan on the next NODE_VERSION bump.

Latest stable is 3.15, but the sdk-check group's openhands-sdk->litellm->fastuuid chain pins fastuuid 0.14.0 (sdist only, no cp315 wheel) and its bundled PyO3 fails to build on 3.15. pydantic-core has shipped cp315 wheels as of 2.50.1, so fastuuid is the sole blocker - re-check when fastuuid publishes a 3.15-capable release.
